comment: Stage -> (provider, model) routing for every model-dispatching stage.
Unknown stages and unknown providers raise: no silent fallback to Codex.
Kolby rulings 2026-08-10: Codex is judge/audit-only in the durable
system; GLM takes a bulk stage ONLY after the Phase-3 agreement gate
measures it (auto-freeze on breach). Flipping a stage is a one-line
policy edit here, reviewed and committed - never an env var.
candidate_provider documents the intended cheap lane for each stage;
it has no runtime effect until promoted into provider.
